decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment of GitHub Agentic Workflows (Actions). Sources still describe a technical preview; no stage change found. Separate from the experimental session-SDK Dynamic Workflows. Conservative automated review only; human dates and findings are unchanged.

citations.quote: The feature is available in technical preview through the gh aw CLI extension.
This path requires an organization Copilot subscription with centralized billing.

findings.reason: The announcement (2026-02-13) names a technical preview. Current stage, account eligibility, and a tested client are not confirmed.
findings.next: Recheck the current stage and eligibility with a named pilot cohort.

findings.reason: No fetched evidence shows an enterprise policy that disables or restricts the capability.
findings.next: Test an enforceable Actions policy with a negative enforcement test.
